what: wait for (-1, -1) (where the save stands, unwritten in the fixture) to be witnessed; walk home to (0, 0) so a joiner's spawn chunk is written

repeat.until: (async () => { const S = await import('/state/index.ts'); const c = S.useLandStore.getState().chunks['-1,-1']; return c !== undefined && c.status !== 'writing' })()

actions.eval: (async () => { const S = await import('/state/index.ts'); const c = S.useLandStore.getState().chunks['-1,-1']; const p = (await import('/engine/playerProbe.ts')).samplePlayer(); return JSON.stringify({ status: c?.status, name: c?.scene?.name ?? null, at: [p.x, p.z] }) })()

repeat.until: (async () => { const S = await import('/state/index.ts'); const c = S.useLandStore.getState().chunks['0,0']; return c !== undefined && c.status !== 'writing' })()

actions.eval: (async () => { const S = await import('/state/index.ts'); const H = await import('/history/index.ts'); const c = S.useLandStore.getState().chunks['0,0']; return JSON.stringify({ status: c?.status, name: c?.scene?.name ?? null, head: H.worldNow().head.n, chunks: Object.keys(H.worldNow().chunks) }) })()
